title: Single-use pass-through wrappers add indirection with no naming gain
detail: Both wrappers are one-line delegations to functions from modules already imported in the file, each called exactly once (lines 643 and 652). The wrapped names are no clearer than the originals; direct calls are simpler.
recommended_fix: Delete both wrappers; call form_view.current_unix_ms() - 30_000 and test_helpers.near_future_iso_date() inline at the two call sites.

title: Third inline copy of the minimal-valid-submission multipart fixture
detail: The ~25-field valid-submission values list now exists in three integration files (gdpr's apply_form_fixture_values, application_integration_test's inline copy, and here). helpers.gleam's own doc comment reserves it for helpers used by two or more feature-area files; AGENTS.md's DRY rule trips at 2+ repeats. Pre-existing debt, deepened by this PR.
recommended_fix: Hoist gdpr_integration_test's apply_form_fixture_values(email:, has_guarantor:) into server/test/integration/helpers.gleam and call it from all three files; defer if a follow-up cleanup PR is preferred.
